codes.definition: 用户要的是一个行动裁决：对一个可识别对象（点名的证券、基金、商品、指数、板块、产品或产品类型，或『这只/这些』这类指代）该不该买、卖、持有、申购、加仓、建仓、抄底、做T，或者在什么时机、什么价位动手。
codes.include_rules: 谓语是行动动词（买/买入/入手/申购/持有/格局/卖/卖出/加仓/建仓/抄底/进/投资/做T/定投），且带情态或评价词（能/可以/值得/适合/合适/划算/该/要不要/有必要/建议/时机/价位/买点）。包括：『值得投资吗』『适合长期持有吗/适合长线吗』『适合短线还是长线』『什么价位买入/最佳买入点/何时适合抄底/卖出最佳时机』。用户交代了自己的持仓（我买了/底仓/亏损X个点/全仓）并问接下来怎么办。『后续操作有什么建议』。对一组指代标的问是/否式适合度（『这些标的适合我…吗』）。『机会还是风险』这类要进场与否两面裁决的问法。按功能判、不看主题：点名险种『有必要买吗』、自有物品卖多少钱合适，都算。
codes.exclude_rules: 问的是『哪只/哪些该买』，答案要点出标的 → SELECT。只问价格或方向、不问要不要动手（还能涨吗）→ FORECAST。评价名词做谓语（投资价值/前景/潜力/怎么样），无行动动词 → APPRAISE。对象由条件定义、没有具体标的（股票等1年赚10%值得吗、换手率26%该买还是该卖、基金收益超过10%要不要卖）→ RULE。交易制度问『能不能买卖』（当天买入当天可以卖吗、300的股票能不能买）→ INFO。只问风险或安全（现在买入XX安全吗）→ RISK；行动谓语与风险问句同在时，归 DECIDE。
examples: 海南机场股票现在能买吗
中国铀业股票可以长期持有吗
301630值得申购吗
恒逸石化什么价位买入
新能源汽车损失险有必要买吗

codes.definition: 对某个可识别对象的未来作判断：价格水平、涨跌方向、幅度、持续时间或时点，或者某个具体公司/市场事件的未来结果或价格影响。用户不要求行动裁决。
codes.include_rules: 线索词：会涨/会跌/还会/还能涨/能涨到/跌到/目标价/上涨空间/翻倍/几个涨停/能否继续涨停/何时反弹/还能炒多久/预测/预计/后市/后期。『走势如何/走势怎么样』带近期、最近或无时间词，且没有已完成标记（了/已经/历史）。上市首日能涨多少、中签能赚多少、上市价预计多少。具体事件的利好利空或影响（XX要在港股上市是利好吗、某次财报对股价有何影响、今晚美联储数据利好还是利空）。有利或中性的公司事件是否会发生（重组、整合、合作、业绩预期、亏损何时结束）。大盘/A股/股市/指数、黄金白银、外汇、点名板块，都算可识别对象。时间段加价位、无完成标记（比亚迪2026年股价是多少）。陈述句里带价格方向或幅度判断（我认为黄金还会回调到X、XX未来10倍牛股、XX今天有望上涨）。用户交代了持仓但只问价格结果（全仓买了XX，可能有2个涨停吧）。
codes.exclude_rules: 问要不要买卖 → DECIDE。答案是一组由预测条件选出的标的（今日哪些会涨停、预计下个月上涨的板块、股价有望翻倍的有哪些）→ SELECT。不利的状态事件（ST、退市、破发、上市失败）或明确的风险/亏损/安全措辞 → RISK。仅『未来』+潜力/前景/成长空间/增长空间 → APPRAISE（『未来』本身不算预测线索）。循环条件下的规律，即使点名了资产也没有具体日期或事件（经济衰退时黄金会先跌后涨吗、pce上升黄金涨还是跌）→ RULE。泛称事件类型（回购是利好还是利空）→ RULE。第三方预测（哪些投行预测最乐观、目标价有哪些机构支持）→ INFO。已发生的行情或原因（今日涨跌情况如何、为什么跌）→ INFO。
examples: 大唐发电明天会涨还是会跌呀
金价还会继续下跌吗
赛轮轮胎股票短期目标价是多少
天博智能上市首日能涨多少
格林美要在港股上市是利好吗

codes.definition: 对一个具体对象的当前质量、价值、估值是否合理，或长期前景作评价性判断，不带价格方向，也不要求行动。
codes.include_rules: 谓语是评价名词或评价性问句：怎么样/怎样/如何（无行动动词）/好不好/前景/发展前景/潜力/潜质/成长空间/增长空间/投资价值/是否具有投资价值/估值多少合理/高估还是低估/是否低估/靠谱吗/可靠吗/口碑/性价比如何/档次/算强势吗/概念强吗/是否符合某投资标准/业绩如何（带评价）/有没有烂板妖股特征。按功能判：对点名的基金、债券、保险产品或服务作评价也算。
codes.exclude_rules: 同句里带行动问句（怎么样，能买吗）→ DECIDE。带上涨空间/翻倍/目标价/涨跌 → FORECAST（并存时 FORECAST 优先）。只要数字、没有评价（新凯来估值、动态市盈率是多少、估值百分位）→ INFO。评价的是条件定义的类别而非具体标的（股票发行价整体偏高还是偏低、市盈率高好还是低好）→ RULE。两个及以上具体候选之间比较 → SELECT。风险或安全措辞 → RISK。
examples: 省广集团股票怎么样
太极实业股票的前景怎样
688826股票有投资价值吗
沃尔核材的股价是否低估
中国核电估值多少合理

codes.name_zh: 荐股/择优（按评价或前瞻标准点名标的）
codes.definition: 答案要点出用户该看好的标的，挑选依据是评价性或前瞻性的。标的可以来自开放范围（荐股、推荐、最好的、潜力股、会涨的有哪些），也可以是用户列出的封闭候选（A和B哪个更…、这些股票中哪只最…）。
codes.include_rules: 开放范围：推荐/建议/给我挑/该买哪些/适合进哪只/最好/比较好/好的/不错/优质/最有潜力/潜力股/值得/适合/性价比/厉害/最看好/最赚钱/牛股，或『会涨停/上涨/有望翻倍/重组预期/轮动/异动』的有哪些，对象是证券、基金、ETF、板块、理财、保险方案、软件或服务商。评价词和指标过滤同时出现时仍归此类（给我推荐ROE大于8%的低价股、业绩好还在低位的有哪些）。检索短语式『值得买股票』『建议购买股票』归此类。封闭候选：点名两个及以上候选（证券、板块、市场、产品），或用『这些/这三只/这几家』指代，并问哪个更好、更值得、更有潜力、更有投资价值、会有主升浪、收益更大；没有『哪个』的比较或对比（A和B对比、各钢铁股比较）也算。
codes.exclude_rules: 选取依据只有关联、成员身份或客观指标（龙头/概念/相关/受益/排名前十/股息率最高/市盈率最低/股价X元左右/涨幅靠后）→ SCREEN。对一组标的问是/否（这些标的适合我吗、这些龙头股适合现在入手吗）→ DECIDE。候选是条件定义的类别或泛称资产类型（上涨的ETF还是低估值ETF、股票指数混合纯债基金哪个适合）→ RULE。封闭集合里只比指标（这三期数据中哪个账号盈利最高）→ INFO。一个是原因、一个是标的（康宁大涨京东方会涨吗）→ FORECAST。
examples: 给我推荐几只港股地产ETF
军工股票推荐
炒完半导体后，哪个板块最有潜力
亨通光电与中天科技哪个更有投资价值
这些股票中哪只最适合长期持有

codes.definition: 用户要的是风险程度：会不会亏、亏多少、安不安全，或某个不利状态事件发生的可能性（ST、退市、破发、上市失败、暴雷）。适用于具体标的，也适用于泛称资产。
codes.include_rules: 明确措辞：风险大吗/风险多大/安全吗/会不会亏/血本无归。不利状态事件：会ST吗/会退市吗/破发概率/上市失败的可能性/摘帽失败的后果。只问风险、没有行动谓语时，泛称资产（买基金风险大吗）也归此类。
codes.exclude_rules: 同句里有 DECIDE 行动问句（能买入吗…风险多大）→ DECIDE。『机会还是风险』→ DECIDE。单纯价格下跌问句（会跌到30元吗、黄金暴跌是真的吗）→ FORECAST。有利或中性的公司事件（重组、上市难度、整合可能性）→ FORECAST。只评可靠性、没有亏损或事件线索（XX靠谱吗）→ APPRAISE。追回过往损失或投资纠纷 → UNSURE。
examples: 买基金风险大吗 会不会亏的血本无归
现在买入中国移动安全吗
众泰汽车股票会ST吗
天博智能上市首日破发概率大吗
飞联天下上市失败的可能性有多大

codes.name_zh: 关联/指标标的清单（无评价标准）
codes.definition: 答案要点出一个或一组可买入或持有的对象（股票、板块、基金、品种、服务商），挑选依据只有关联、成员身份、行业地位或客观指标，不含评价性或前瞻性标准。
codes.include_rules: XX概念股/龙头股/龙头股排名/前十名/一览表/相关股票有哪些/核心概念股/最大受益公司/哪些股票受益/受某政策影响大的股票/对应哪些板块/某机构持仓最大的股票/股息率最高排行榜/市盈率最低的股票/涨跌幅度不大或涨幅靠后的股票/股价X元左右的X股/低价龙头/某品种收益最高/哪家公司能买某险种。『最牛/最强』修饰龙头时仍归此类（最牛三个龙头）。标题式清单片段（有关伊朗方面生意的股票、北京股市中有关机器人的股票）。
codes.exclude_rules: 依据里有任何评价性或前瞻性词（推荐/最好/潜力/值得/适合/性价比/业绩好/会涨/有望/预期）→ SELECT。对单个点名标的问是否属于某概念或是否龙头（利通电子是算力龙头股吗）→ INFO（是/否核实，不是列清单）。单个标的的属性（所属板块、产品、排名、股东）→ INFO，但答案本身是一组证券的除外（某险企持仓最大的十支股票归此类）。答案是机构、人或数值而非可买对象（哪些投行对某股预测最乐观）→ INFO。
examples: 算力股票龙头前十名
氨动力发动机相关股票有哪些
高温天气哪些股票受益
a股股息率最高的公司排行榜
股价4.8左右的军工股有哪些

codes.definition: 用户要的是一条可泛化的判断规则、市场规律或投资方法，不针对某个具体标的的具体时点：面对条件定义的一类情形会怎样、该怎么做，某类指标或事件一般是好是坏，某类资产怎样投资或怎样选。
codes.include_rules: 没有可识别对象、由条件定义的情形：股票涨停后今天还会跌吗、尾盘拉升的股票第二天走势、涨停第二天高量阳线能买吗、换手率26%该买还是该卖、盈利多少个点应该卖、买卖最佳时机、股票等1年赚10%值得吗、重组成功后股价会涨多少。泛称事件类型的利好利空（回购/转股/分红/dr）。类别层面的好坏（市盈率高好还是低好、股权激励价格高好还是低好、股票的优缺点、市盈率多少合适）。点名资产加循环条件、无具体日期或事件（经济衰退时黄金会先跌后涨吗）。策略或方法的『怎样/如何…最好、才能、技巧、方法、怎么选、怎么判断』，即使点名了板块或个股也算（普通散户怎样投资科技股最好、集合竞价怎么判断股票能涨、想买股票不知道怎么选）。泛称资产类型之间的取舍（买上涨的ETF还是低估值ETF、股票指数混合纯债基金哪个适合做护城河）。
codes.exclude_rules: 交代了个人持仓并问怎么办 → DECIDE。有具体对象加具体时间或事件 → FORECAST/DECIDE/APPRAISE。明确风险措辞 → RISK。由制度规定的规则或操作程序（交易时间、T+1、当天能否卖出、保单条款、出险后保费、如何购买、在哪开户）→ INFO，即使问法是『会涨吗/可以卖吗』。约定俗成的概念事实（中国股市绿色是涨还是跌）→ INFO。
examples: 市盈率高的股票好还是低的股票好
股票回购是利好还是利空
尾盘拉升的股票第二天的走势
盈利多少个点应该卖股票
普通的散户怎样投资科技股最好

codes.name_zh: 事实/制度/操作信息（无判断）
codes.definition: 用户要的是可核实的描述性信息，不要评价或前瞻判断：某个对象的属性数值、当前或历史行情状态、所属板块或概念核实、公司业务事实、已发生行情的原因、交易与产品的制度规则和操作程序、第三方观点出处，或一条新闻标题本身。
codes.include_rules: 数值和属性：市盈率/均线/每股收益/净值/现价/历史最高价/上市以来涨了多少倍/转股价/某年最高点（已完成）。所属板块或概念核实（XX属于哪个板块、是CPO概念股吗、有没有某概念、是否龙头）。公司事实（有哪些产品、有合作吗、有机构买入吗、利润从哪来、排名全国第几、什么时候上市、投资多少钱）。当前或已发生状态（今日涨跌情况如何、今天怎么样、哪些板块上涨了、跌得猛的是哪个）。已发生行情的原因（为什么跌、为何不涨、怎么回事）。制度与操作（当天买入当天可以卖吗、15:05后还能买卖吗、跌停后能买卖吗、300的股票能不能买、逆回购周四买周五能再买吗、如何购买某基金、某险种什么年龄可以买、出险后保费会涨吗、能理赔吗）。第三方观点出处（哪些投行预测最乐观、目标价有哪些机构支持）。不带价格方向判断的新闻标题片段（板块火速拉升、某股东股份将被拍卖、潜在大利好）。点名指标之间的静态关系、无事件（某指数对英伟达影响有多大）。
codes.exclude_rules: 答案要点出一组可买对象 → SCREEN（依据为评价性时 → SELECT）。带任何评价或前瞻线索 → 对应的判断码。泛化的好坏或规律判断 → RULE。『走势如何』无完成标记 → FORECAST。标题片段带价格方向或幅度（有望上涨、10倍牛股）→ FORECAST。缺谓语、需要上文才能读懂 → UNSURE。
examples: 万峰锂业动态市盈率是多少倍
金山办公股票属于哪个板块
股票当天买入当天可以卖吗
航天电子股票历史最高价
502时代成长基金如何购买

codes.definition: 仅凭文本无法判定用户想从回答中得到什么：只有产品名、没有问句；截断到缺谓语；乱码或语音转写碎片；依赖对话上文才有指代的抱怨或闲聊；投资纠纷或追回损失这类不属于任何判断功能的请求。
codes.include_rules: 只有实体名或名词短语、没有问句也没有线索词（基金全称单独出现）。碎片化数字或状态片段。截断到请求谓语缺失（证券市场随着科技股下跌那么证券板块）。长段语音转写、闲聊，或针对前一轮回答的质疑，读不出一个主请求。乱码式短语。
codes.exclude_rules: 截断但请求谓语仍可读（…值得买入吗、交代持仓后问怎么办）→ 按可读谓语归码。实体名加明确线索词（XX估值 → INFO，XX目标价 → FORECAST，XX龙头 → SCREEN）不算不可判定。检索短语式省略（值得买股票）→ SELECT。能读出功能的非金融主题（车险怎么买最划算）按功能归码，不因主题归入 UNSURE。
examples: 嘉实价值臻选混合
网下配售股百分之九十
盘后定价买盘五百多手
介绍炒港美股的盈利电商

codebook.tie_break_order: 一行同时符合多个码时，先按下列硬规则判：(a) 没有可识别对象的条件定义情形或方法问句归 RULE，除非交代了个人持仓（→ DECIDE）或含明确风险措辞（→ RISK）；(b) 答案要点出一组可买对象时，依据有评价或前瞻词 → SELECT，否则 → SCREEN；(c) 由制度规定的规则问题一律 INFO。仍有并存时，按用户对回答的投入程度取高者：SELECT > DECIDE > RISK > FORECAST > APPRAISE > SCREEN > RULE > INFO > UNSURE。例：『这隻股票怎么样？值得买入吗？…风险等级是什么？』→ DECIDE；『长电科技…高估还是低估…有没有上涨空间』→ FORECAST；『格力电器适合攒股收息吗它的历史最高价是多少』→ DECIDE；『请分析一下武汉凡谷财报的情况以及后市走势』→ FORECAST。只有在没有任何可读请求谓语时才用 UNSURE，不能用它来回避上面的并存判断。
codebook.pilot_note:
先通读全部682行，写出v1（8码：DECIDE/FORECAST/APPRAISE/CHOOSE/PICK/RISK/RULE/INFO），再按每11行取1行抽60行试标（sid INV0641…INV0201）。试标记录存于 /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mayouxuan-Documents-Claude-Search-Query-Mining-Agent-Team/3deba04e-73b1-4747-b7b7-4d1a40520650/scratchpad/fin8facet_invest_pilot60.csv。60行中有12行要翻规则才能定码，修订后每行都落到唯一一码，另有2行 UNSURE。本试标只有一名标注者（我自己）判两轮，没有第二标注者，因此没有一致性数据；这里的分布说明规则可用，不能证明信度。修改如下：

(1) v1 的 INFO 占60行中27行（45%），而且主要是『XX龙头股/概念股/受益股有哪些』这类清单。这类恰好是『要不要荐股清单』这个研究问题的关键，于是拆出 SCREEN（按关联或指标点名标的，16/60），INFO 缩为纯事实（13/60）。为守住8码上限，把封闭候选比较（A和B哪个更…、这些股票中哪只…）并入开放荐股，合成 SELECT。两者交付的都是『该看好哪只』，试标中比较行为0，全样本约24行（约3.5%）；封闭还是开放可在事后按『点名两个及以上或用这些/这三只指代』机械还原。
(2) 第3行『股票等1年赚10%值得吗』对象由条件定义 → RULE；第13行点名险种『有必要买吗』仍归 DECIDE。据此明确 DECIDE 需要可识别对象。
(3) 第4行：『未来』本身不算 FORECAST 线索。未来潜力、前景、成长空间 → APPRAISE；上涨空间、翻倍 → FORECAST。
(4) 第22行『经济衰退时黄金会先跌后涨吗』：点名资产但处于循环条件、无具体日期或事件 → RULE。FORECAST 须有具体时间范围或具体事件。
(5) 第42行『哪些投行对…预测最乐观』：问的是谁作了什么预测，不是要一个预测 → INFO。
(6) 第46、59行：交易时间、出险后保费这类由制度规定的规则 → INFO，即使问法是『会涨吗/可以买卖吗』。
(7) 第18、58行陈述句：带价格方向或幅度 → FORECAST；其余新闻标题 → INFO。
(8) 第43行：SCREEN/SELECT 的答案必须是可买入或持有的对象，单个公司的产品或排名 → INFO。第47行对一组指代标的问是/否式适合度 → DECIDE，不归 SELECT。
(9) RISK 在试标中为0行，通读全样本约10行（约1.5%），仍保留：研究问题点名了风险，且该意图 risk=true，『几乎没人问风险』本身就是结论。『破发』归入 RISK 线索词，『机会还是风险』判为 DECIDE。

v2 试标分布：SCREEN 16，INFO 13，FORECAST 10，DECIDE 8，APPRAISE 5，RULE 5，UNSURE 2，SELECT 1，RISK 0。

提醒下游：SCREEN、INFO、RULE 合计34/60（57%），都不是真正的投顾请求，说明该意图收进了大量主题清单和事实类行。另有少量非金融主题行（车险、奶粉、显卡转卖、房产）按功能归码，主题仍由叶节点承载。所有示例均已脚本核对为文件中的原文。

codes.definition: The user wants a feed of whatever is new about an entity, event or market. They name no single fact to be answered, and the answer is a list or summary of recent news items.
codes.include_rules: (a) Explicit feed wording with no narrower question word: 最新消息 / 今天最新消息 / 最新公告 / 最新动态 / 最新情况 / 最新状况 / 重大消息 / 利好消息 / 好消息, including when attached to an event topic (X重组最新消息, 泰安股份停牌最新消息). (b) Asking whether any news of a polarity exists, or what news there is: 有什么利好 / 有哪些重大利好消息 / 出什么利空了吗 / 有好消息吗 / 有重大利好吗 on a date, with no future marker. (c) A statement or announcement whose type is not given (X声明, X官宣), or a news outlet joined to an entity. (d) A declarative news-headline string, read as a whole. Question words inside a quoted remark do not count (董明珠:家电不换成格力凭什么分红; 英伟达即将发布业绩).
codes.exclude_rules: Feed wording on the same row as a progress, status or timing question (进度 / 进展 / 了吗 / 什么时候 / 休市吗) goes to STATUS_TIMING (合利宝退市了吗最新消息). Feed wording joined to a single quantity or result noun (牌价 / 价格 / 中签 / 中奖信息) goes to FACT_DETAIL (中国银行外汇牌价今日最新消息). Feed wording joined to 预测 goes to FORECAST. Feed wording joined to an explicit analysis request goes to ASSESS_JUDGE (今天股市最新消息新股市行情分析). A bare entity plus an event or document noun with no feed wording (交通银行二季度财报) goes to FACT_DETAIL. Rows with 下周 / 明天 plus 有无利好 go to FORECAST.
examples: 宝武镁业今天最新消息
杭电股份目前有哪些重大利好消息
华建重组最新消息
迅游科技最新公告今天
京东发布关于稳定币的声明

codes.definition: The user wants to know where one specific event or process instance stands on its timeline: whether it has happened, what stage it is at, whether it is finished, or on what date or time it happens, happened or is scheduled.
codes.include_rules: Specific entity or instance plus: 什么时候 / 何时 / 哪天 / 啥时候 / 哪年 / 时间 / 日期 / 时间表 / 登记日 / 解禁日 / 除权除息日 / 开放日, including a date phrased as 日期是多少. Also 进度 / 进展 / 审核得怎么样了 / 完成了吗 / 上市了没有 / 退市了吗 / 有复牌吗 / 休市吗 / 可否进入了 / 有上市计划吗 / 有没有在正常生产. 预计 attached to a schedule stays here: 长鑫存储预计上市时间, 中国广电增持歌华有线预计何时启动. A 什么时候 question about an uncertain future event also stays here unless an explicit prediction marker is present (ST新动力2025年什么时候摘掉帽子). A calendar of dates across many entities belongs here when the ask is the dates (近期上市公司开股东大会时间).
codes.exclude_rules: No specific entity or instance, only a generic class or a general norm (上市公司披露中报日期, 半年报一般什么时间公布, 多久能上市): RULE_CONCEPT. An explicit 预测 / 预估 / 概率 / 可能性 / 能…吗 on the timing: FORECAST (华润新能源上市时间预测). 'When should I buy or add to a position' is about the user's own action, not an event: ASSESS_JUDGE (西部超导什么时候补仓). Asking which entities are upcoming, not when: FACT_DETAIL (2026年7月即将上市新股). A status word appears only as part of feed wording (停牌最新消息): LATEST_NEWS.
examples: 长鑫存储什么时候上市
ST亿晶的重整进度如何
韩建河山收购兴福新材完成了吗
招商银行分红登记日
08297今天有复牌吗

codes.definition: The user wants the content of a specific disclosed item or a checkable fact: a figure, a document or its contents, a list of items or entities, or an attribute. Any date or time attribute is excluded.
codes.include_rules: (a) A bare entity, optionally with a period, plus an event or document noun and no feed wording: 交通银行二季度财报, 宜化激励性配股公告, 拓普集团半年业绩预告, 中国石化分红, 中科飞测上市. (b) Quantities: 多少 / 金额 / 净利润 / 营收 / 市值 / 估值有多少 (with no estimate marker) / 中签率 / 发行价 / 融资额 / 股东人数 / 负债率 / 主力资金 / 融券余额. (c) Lists and profiles: 有哪些 + entity noun / 一览 / 名单 / 是谁 / 简介 / 全部资料 / 详细数据 / 全文 / pdf, including 最新中报预增股一览. (d) 情况 or 怎么样 attached to a disclosed quantity: 航天发展2026分红情况, 潍柴重机2026年一季度业绩怎么样. (e) Numeric comparisons computable from facts: …净利润是…的多少倍. (f) Entity-specific frequency or policy: 中国电键一年每年分红几次. (g) Feed wording attached to one datum noun: 中国银行外汇牌价今日最新消息, 宇树科技最新中奖信息. Note that 业绩预告, 预增 and 预披露 are names of disclosure documents, not forecasts.
codes.exclude_rules: The requested attribute is a date or time: STATUS_TIMING. The quantity is a projection (预测 / 预估 / 估计 / 预期 / 目标价 / 会有多少 / 预计 + value): FORECAST. A list screened by likelihood (很可能大增的…股票): FORECAST. A comparison asking which is better or more worth it, or a request for 对比分析: ASSESS_JUDGE. A general rule or norm with no specific entity: RULE_CONCEPT. Generic feed wording (最新消息, 利好消息) with no datum noun: LATEST_NEWS.
examples: 交通银行二季度财报
长鑫科技申购中签率
欧伦电气十大股东是谁
稳定币次新股有哪些
安森美年销售收了多少总股本多少

codes.definition: The user wants general knowledge about how something works: a standing or newly issued regulation, a disclosure norm, a typical procedure or timeline, or a concept. The object is the rule, not one occurrence.
codes.include_rules: 规定 / 要求 / 规则 / 新规 / 新规定 / 一般 / 最迟 / 最晚 / 多久 / 几次 / 模式 / 流程, when no specific entity instance is the subject, or the entity only illustrates the rule. This includes a generic class plus a disclosure date (上市公司披露中报日期, 中报什么时候披露). Also hypothetical questions about what the rules require or allow, even when an entity is named: ST易购如有重大利好会提前公布吗?如Q2营收大超预期. A request for a regulation document (…规定条款pdf) also belongs here.
codes.exclude_rules: A specific named entity's own schedule, status or policy: STATUS_TIMING or FACT_DETAIL (中国电键一年每年分红几次 goes to FACT_DETAIL). A new policy written as a declarative headline: LATEST_NEWS. 为什么 about a rule: EXPLAIN_CAUSE. 概率 / 可能性 questions, even generic ones (重组成功概率大吗): FORECAST. A bare concept or product name with no question word and no rule noun (上市未盈利, 中汽转债): UNSURE.
examples: 半年报一般什么时间公布
赴美上市递交招股书后多久能上市
主板st新规定
股票一年出几次季报
7月1号存款新规

codes.definition: The user wants the reasons behind an event, result, state or price move that has already happened or already exists.
codes.include_rules: Explicit reason markers: 为什么 / 为何 / 原因 / 怎么回事 / 怎么变(少/多) / 凭什么 (outside a quoted headline). Applies to a company event (退市原因, 为何不上市), a result (业绩大增原因), a regulatory state (为什么没ST) or a price move (为什么涨停). Price-move 'why' rows sit under NEWS_EVENT only because of upstream routing; code their function here anyway. When a why-question is joined to a factual comparison, the why decides: 中际旭创和寒武纪估值谁高，为什么寒武纪涨不了源杰那么高.
codes.exclude_rules: Surprise with no reason marker (五粮液改财报竟然没事) or a bare statement (九目化学从上市就没有交易): UNSURE, because the function is implied rather than asked. A why joined to an explicit estimate request (…大概预估是多少为什么…): FORECAST. A why joined to an explicit analysis or advice request: ASSESS_JUDGE. A headline 'Name: quote' whose quote contains 凭什么: LATEST_NEWS. Asking the effect of an event rather than its cause: ASSESS_JUDGE.
examples: 海科新源今年业绩大增原因？？
TCL科技业绩预增的原因是什么?
世优科技为何不上市
中百集团连续几年亏损为什么没ST
上海沪工今天为什么涨停板

codes.definition: The user wants an evaluative judgement about a given event, result or entity: whether it is good or bad, what its effect or significance is, an interpretation or analysis, a which-is-better comparison, or advice on what to do.
codes.include_rules: (a) Polarity of a given item: 公告利好吗 / 利好还是利空 / 是利好吗. (b) Effect of a named event, even when the effect lies in the future: 影响多大 / 有伤害吗 / 有关联吗 / 如果成功会怎么样 / 对…是利好还是利空 (Q2汇兑损失对下半年利润影响多大, 新粉上市对价格影响有多大). (c) An explicit analysis or interpretation request: 分析 / 解读 / 形态分析 / 对比分析 / 优势 / 处于第几浪. (d) Advice: 建议 / 策略 / 什么时候补仓 / 给个投资建议. (e) An evaluative characterization: 过热了吗 / 是老登股吗 / 趋势如何 with no future marker. (f) A screen defined by a judgement criterion (未启动的军工股).
codes.exclude_rules: 怎么样 or 如何 attached to a disclosed quantity or state is a lookup: FACT_DETAIL (业绩怎么样, 分红情况怎么样) or STATUS_TIMING (审核得怎么样了). Existence of news (有重大利好吗 / 有什么利好) rather than the polarity of a given item: LATEST_NEWS. 分析 joined to 预测, or any explicit projection of a value, direction or likelihood: FORECAST (海光信息周四走势预测分析). A projected number without effect wording goes to FORECAST even after a named event (重组完成后节能铁汉的资产负债率能降到多少). Numeric 多少倍 or 谁高 comparisons of facts: FACT_DETAIL.
examples: 海兰信昨天公告利好吗
Q2汇兑损失对下半年利润影响多大
鞍钢股份2026年上半年财务报告详细解读
建邦股份和常青科技业务对比分析
同宇新材申购建议

codes.definition: The user wants a projection: whether a future or undecided event will happen and how likely it is, its prospects, or the future or estimated value or direction of a quantity (price, target price, earnings, valuation, market move, IPO subscription outcome). This holds whether the answerer produces the projection or a named institution published it.
codes.include_rules: 预测 / 预估 / 估计 / 预期 / 概率 / 可能性 / 有可能…吗 / 会不会 / 能…吗 about a specific or generic event (能上市吗, 会重组吗, 重组成功概率大吗) / 有机会 / 前景 / 未来 / 有望 / 还能继续 / 目标价, including one attributed to a named source (高盛给京东方A目标价). 预计 attached to a value, gain or evaluation (上市后股价预计是多少, 上市预计涨幅, 二季报预计怎么样). 申购预测. Market-direction questions (下周一股市最新预测, 创新药今天能涨吗). Rows with 下周 / 明天 plus 有无利好或利空. Screens by likelihood (2026年中报业绩很可能大增的创新药股票).
codes.exclude_rules: 预计 attached to a schedule (预计上市时间, 预计何时启动) or a plain when-question about a future event: STATUS_TIMING. Only an explicit 预测 on the timing keeps a row here. Effect of a named event phrased as 影响 / 利好利空 / 伤害 / 关联 / 会怎么样: ASSESS_JUDGE. Disclosure documents with 预 in the name (业绩预告, 预增, 预披露): FACT_DETAIL or RULE_CONCEPT. What a rule requires or allows (会提前公布吗 as a disclosure obligation; 多久能上市 as a procedure): RULE_CONCEPT. A valuation or market cap asked with no estimate marker: FACT_DETAIL.
examples: 嘉泰激光北交所IPO上市概率多大
国电南自有可能被并购重组吗
2026年润泽科技股价预测目标是多少
下周一股市最新预测
华润新能源上市预计涨幅

codes.definition: The user wants help with their own account, application, payment or transaction, or is complaining about a service. The answer is operational help, not information about a public event.
codes.include_rules: A personal state or failure: 支付失败 / 到账了吗 (about a payment made to the user) / 一直审核中 / 额度关闭 / 合同生成 / 转人工难. Complaints about reaching customer service. Applies when the row describes the user's own case, even though no first-person pronoun appears.
codes.exclude_rules: A public campaign's or product's schedule or attribute with no sign of the user's own case (…红包何时过期, 模拟炒股大赛有奖金吗): STATUS_TIMING or FACT_DETAIL. How a lending or approval process works in general: RULE_CONCEPT. A platform notice or recruitment title whose purpose might be to take part or to read news: UNSURE.
examples: chatgpt支付失败
兰州银行打入的2026年华裔慰问金都到账了吗
公积金贷款显示合同生成

codes.definition: The text alone does not show what the user wants from the answer. Typical cases are a bare entity, product or concept name with no event noun, feed wording or question word; a garbled or fragmentary string; or a statement whose request is only implied.
codes.include_rules: A bare name (institution, index, bond, fund or insurance product) with no event noun or question marker. Fragments and garbled strings. Statements of surprise or observation with no explicit ask (竟然没事, 从上市就没有交易). Notice titles where information-seeking and participation cannot be told apart. Product advertising copy.
codes.exclude_rules: A bare entity with an event or document noun (X分红, X上市, X年报): FACT_DETAIL. A bare entity with feed wording: LATEST_NEWS. A declarative event headline (subject + 宣布 / 发布 / 拟 / 获受理 / 出炉 / 筹划 / 已成功 / 新增): LATEST_NEWS. Use UNSURE only when no rule for another code fires. Do not use it to settle a two-code conflict; the tie-break order settles those.
examples: 1989年银行使用电脑
GTC泽汇资本
道琼斯美国石油开发与生产指数
中汽转债
九目化学从上市就没有交易

codebook.tie_break_order: First apply each code's own exclusion carve-outs; they settle marker collisions by definition. Examples: 预计 + a schedule goes to STATUS_TIMING; effect wording goes to ASSESS_JUDGE, not FORECAST; 怎么样 on a disclosed quantity is a lookup; feed wording on a single datum noun goes to FACT_DETAIL. Only when a row genuinely asks two functions does the first matching code in this order win: SERVICE_HELP > FORECAST > ASSESS_JUDGE > EXPLAIN_CAUSE > RULE_CONCEPT > STATUS_TIMING > FACT_DETAIL > LATEST_NEWS > UNSURE. The order runs from the most demanding function to the least, so a lookup word such as 最新消息 or 时间 never hides an explicit request to predict, judge or explain. For reporting, roll codes into families: consulting = FORECAST + ASSESS_JUDGE + EXPLAIN_CAUSE; lookup = LATEST_NEWS + STATUS_TIMING + FACT_DETAIL; knowledge = RULE_CONCEPT; other = SERVICE_HELP. Compute shares with UNSURE removed from the denominator, and report the UNSURE count next to them.
codebook.pilot_note: Pilot: 60 rows, taken every 9th row starting at position 4 across all 542 rows. Hand-coded twice, once with draft v1 and once after revision. Files: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mayouxuan-Documents-Claude-Search-Query-Mining-Agent-Team/3deba04e-73b1-4747-b7b7-4d1a40520650/scratchpad/fin8facet_news_pilot60_coded.csv (columns v1, v2). 12 of 60 rows (20%) changed code. Changes: (1) LATEST_NEWS narrowed. In v1 it also held a bare entity + event/document noun, but a period report or a typed announcement asks for that one item, not a feed, so those moved to FACT_DETAIL (交通银行二季度财报, 宜化激励性配股公告, 航天发展2026分红情况). LATEST_NEWS now needs explicit feed wording or a declarative headline. (2) Feed wording joined to a single datum noun now goes to FACT_DETAIL (外汇牌价今日最新消息, 最新中奖信息). (3) STATUS_TIMING now needs a specific entity or instance, so a generic class plus a disclosure date moved to RULE_CONCEPT (上市公司披露中报日期). For the same reason, entity-specific frequency (中国电键一年每年分红几次) moved from RULE_CONCEPT to FACT_DETAIL. (4) A when-question about an uncertain future event had been FORECAST in v1 and now stays STATUS_TIMING unless an explicit prediction marker appears (ST新动力…什么时候摘掉帽子). An explicit 预计 rule was added: 预计 + schedule goes to STATUS_TIMING, 预计 + value/gain/怎么样 goes to FORECAST; the file has 11 预计 rows. (5) Numeric 多少倍 comparisons moved from ASSESS_JUDGE to FACT_DETAIL; which-is-better comparisons stay in ASSESS_JUDGE. (6) Likelihood and prospects (前景, 很可能大增的…股票) now sit inside FORECAST, and FORECAST beats a list lookup. ASSESS_JUDGE is limited to judging a given event, its effect, an explicit analysis, or advice. (7) A loan-platform notice title moved to UNSURE, because information-seeking and participation cannot be told apart. (8) The 60-row pilot drew zero ASSESS_JUDGE rows; a marker scan suggests about 15-20 of 542. So I checked every 分析/建议/影响/利好吗/怎么样 hit across the whole file. That check added two rules: 怎么样 is not an ASSESS marker (业绩怎么样 goes to FACT_DETAIL, 审核得怎么样了 to STATUS_TIMING), and existence of news (有重大利好吗) goes to LATEST_NEWS while polarity of a given item (公告利好吗) goes to ASSESS_JUDGE. All 78 example strings used in the codebook were checked to be verbatim rows. v2 pilot counts: STATUS_TIMING 16, FACT_DETAIL 15, FORECAST 10, LATEST_NEWS 10, RULE_CONCEPT 4, EXPLAIN_CAUSE 2, UNSURE 2, SERVICE_HELP 1, ASSESS_JUDGE 0. Caveats for the lead's source comparison: (a) this pilot had one coder, so no agreement figure exists; get a second coder before reporting any share. (b) ASSESS_JUDGE and EXPLAIN_CAUSE will have small n in a 542-row sample, so compare the consulting family, not single codes. (c) The codes fire on explicit phrasing, and longer, more conversational queries carry more explicit markers. A source gap in consulting share could therefore partly reflect query length rather than intent, so run the comparison within query-length bands as well.

codes.definition: The user wants a recommendation about their own next move. The answer they need is 'yes, do it', 'no, don't' or 'it depends on you', not a fact. A row can be phrased as 'X能…吗' and still belong here.
codes.include_rules: Include (a) any row with an advice word: 值得 / 有必要 / 适合 / 该不该 / 要不要 / 建议 / 划算 / 入手 / 持有 / 长期拿. (b) 买入 / 可以买 / 能买 / 可不可以买 when the object is a specific named security, fund, coin or insurance product, or when no object is named at all (买入 is trading talk). (c) A first-person plan ending in an approval tag (可不可以 / 行不行 / 好不好). (d) '能…吗' about a life or money choice where no institution grants or refuses anything, e.g. whether to quit a job, given the user's own income, debt or age. (e) 'Why is X not recommended' questions (为什么不建议…).
codes.exclude_rules: If a stated rule decides whether the purchase is possible (account type, board, amount threshold, a membership or age condition), code the rule instead: SERVICE_RULE, or ELIGIBILITY_COVER when a person's status is the deciding factor. If the row only asks whether something is good, safe or cheap and never asks whether to act, use MERIT_SAFETY. '可以买吗' about a whole market or asset class with no advice word and no time word could be a rule question or an advice question, so use UNSURE_FUNCTION. When a row has both an evaluation and an action ask (可靠吗…能买吗), DECISION_ADVICE wins.
examples: 同宇新材值得申购吗?
车损险有必要买吗
网宿科技适合长线持有吗
众安保险可靠吗能买吗?
23岁适合买轻疾 中疾病 重疾 终身的吗

codes.definition: The user wants a judgement of how safe, trustworthy, legitimate, risky or good an entity, product, channel or action is. The answer they need is a rating, not a rule.
codes.include_rules: Include rows where the thing asked about is described by 安全 / 可靠 / 靠谱 / 有保障 / 风险(大) / 危险 / 正规 / 合法, said of an institution or platform / 诈骗 / 骗局 / 真的吗, said of a platform or offer / 会倒闭 / 缺点 / 好吗 / 好不好 / 稳固 / 准吗 / 有用吗 / 便宜吗 / 快吗 / 更便捷 / 利好 / 好事还是坏事. Also include merit or ranking labels (龙头, 低估, 纯概念无业务). Also include exposure to theft, fraud, data leaks or misuse by someone without authority (会被诈骗吗, 会被别人用掉吗, 别人用我手机号…有影响吗). Also include whether a phone number, text message, app or caller is really who it claims to be.
codes.exclude_rules: If the row also asks whether to act, use DECISION_ADVICE. If the 'risk' is a consequence the rules impose on the user's own timing or action (being counted as late, penalties, a credit mark), use IMPACT_EXPOSURE. How easy it is to get approved (好下 / 容易贷 / 能下款) goes to ELIGIBILITY_COVER. A neutral type label with no praise or judgement (是国企吗, 是科技股吗) goes to CATEGORY_CHECK. MERIT_SAFETY beats every code except DECISION_ADVICE.
examples: 余额宝存钱安全可靠吗
邮政手机app定期存款安全吗
中信银行信用卡好吗
支付宝里面的高德打车经济型这个接单快吗
友邦优享长伴终身护理保险有哪些缺点

codes.definition: Something the user holds or has already done went wrong or is regretted: a card, account, passbook, deposit slip, policy, payment, order, booking or phone. The user asks whether it can be undone, cancelled, refunded, recovered or replaced, or whether it (or what it made possible) still works.
codes.include_rules: Include only when BOTH (a) and (b) hold. (a) The text marks an existing object or completed act: 丢了 / 过期 / 到期了 / 注销了 / 封了 / 冻结 / 停机 / 暂停 / 降额 / 删了 / 没激活 / 长期未用 / 误点 / 被扣 / 被别人绑定 / 错过了 / 停交 / 不满意, or a sign of holding it such as 显示… / 我的… / 交了 / 买了 / 开通了 / 延迟到账. (b) The question asks about 还能(用/取/转/查) / 取消 / 退(款/保) / 撤回 / 追回 / 找回 / 补办 / 恢复 / 影响…正常使用. Some verbs count on their own because they only make sense after harm: 追回 / 索赔 / 补办 / 补卡 / 挂失 / 撤回资金, and refunds of a fee or charge already paid (服务费能退吗).
codes.exclude_rules: Conditionals and general questions with no marker (一旦开通了…能取消吗, 定期存款可以提前取吗) go to SERVICE_RULE. A marker with a question that is not about undoing, recovery or continued use (卡注销后银行卡会收回吗, 过户了保险可以改为自己买吗) goes to SERVICE_RULE. 还能 / 还可以 alone does NOT trigger this code. Whether insurance pays for an accident goes to ELIGIBILITY_COVER. Harm to creditworthiness (being flagged by a lender's risk controls, a messy credit record) followed by a new loan or card request goes to ELIGIBILITY_COVER. Effects on the credit record or legal liability go to IMPACT_EXPOSURE. Fear of theft or misuse goes to MERIT_SAFETY.
examples: 银行卡丢了可以补办原卡号吗
存单丢了还能取出存款吗
银行卡过期后还能继续使用吗
支付宝显示停车缴费可以取消吗
转账记录删了还能查出来吗

codes.definition: The answer depends on WHO is asking or WHAT CASE is involved, and an institution or rule grants or refuses it. Three kinds: can this person or organisation get access; may someone with this status act; does this insurance pay for this case.
codes.include_rules: (a) ACCESS: getting or applying for something (办卡, 开户, 贷款, 借, 买保险, 投保, 入学, 上市, 兑换) while the row states a circumstance of the applicant: age, minor, student, retiree, occupation, ID type, residency, credit or debt status, not having the required card or phone, membership, company structure. Apply the DELETION TEST: delete the circumstance, and if the question vanishes or becomes an obvious yes, the circumstance is the hinge and the row belongs here. Also include approval odds (能下款 / 好下 / 好批 / 容易贷), refusals (不让办 / 不给开 / 为什么不让办) and 'does X affect my loan, mortgage or card application' (…影响贷款 / 房贷 / 办卡吗). (b) STATUS PERMISSION: whether a person with a stated status (minor, child, civil servant, investment adviser, not the account holder, acting for someone else) may do something, again passing the deletion test. (c) COVERAGE: whether an insurance product covers or pays for a named incident, illness, treatment, item, vehicle or person (能赔 / 能报销 / 报吗 / 保…吗 / 管大病 / 能走交强险).
codes.exclude_rules: A condition on the operation itself rather than on the person (不绑卡, 没有预留手机号, 信用账户, an amount, a time, a place) goes to SERVICE_RULE. A person word that is only part of a product name (大学生助学贷款, 学平险) is not a stated circumstance. A circumstance that fails the deletion test (被授权人 in 共济账户当年能用吗) goes to SERVICE_RULE. Personal circumstances where no gatekeeper exists go to DECISION_ADVICE. Effects on the credit record itself, on premiums or on liability go to IMPACT_EXPOSURE. Recourse after a disputed claim (赔偿不满意可以找…吗) goes to REMEDY_UNDO. Classification questions (算出险吗) go to CATEGORY_CHECK.
examples: 满15周岁可以办银行卡吗
教师退休后可以贷款吗
存折不是本人能取钱吗
猫的眼睛有病保了宠物险能报销吗
开车追尾能走交强险

codes.definition: The user asks whether a stated condition or action brings a consequence that lands on them without their choosing. Four kinds count: a mark on the credit record or score; a legal or contractual obligation; a premium rise or an automatic charge; their records being disclosed to or checked by a legitimate third party.
codes.include_rules: Include 上征信 / 影响征信 / 影响信用 / 保费受影响 / 保费会增加 / 会扣钱 / 每月扣钱 / 不用会收费 / 会抽贷 / 会执行 / 还要继续还吗 / 会二次偿还吗 / 会查征信 / 会查流水 / 能查到我的存款 / 跟…有关系吗 (a restriction spreading to linked accounts) / 被CRS…正常吗. Also include '有危险 / 有风险吗' when the danger is a rule-imposed consequence of the user's own timing or action (for example repaying at 10 pm).
codes.exclude_rules: An effect on whether an application gets approved (影响贷款 / 房贷 / 办卡) goes to ELIGIBILITY_COVER. Whether a held object still works after something went wrong (身份证过期影响银行卡使用吗) goes to REMEDY_UNDO. Fraud, theft or leaks by someone without authority go to MERIT_SAFETY. Ordinary product behaviour with no such burden (卡号会变吗, 额度会恢复吗, 会有短信吗, 会收回卡吗) and fees for an operation the user chooses (转账要钱吗) go to SERVICE_RULE. How a credit score updates when no trigger is stated goes to SERVICE_RULE.
examples: 美团月付上征信吗
车险无责出险一次第二年保费受影响吗
入职公司会查征信吗
银行工作人员拿身份证能查到名下存款吗
股票账户开通后不用会收费吗

codes.definition: The user wants a classification or identity ruling. Is X a member of class Y, which of classes A or B is it, are two named things the same, is X included in or counted as Y? The thing asked about is a class or type label, not a judgement of quality.
codes.include_rules: Include 是A还是B where A and B are types (国企 / 私企 / 央企, 主板 / 科创板, 理财 / 基金, 对公 / 对私, 中介 / 直接放款). Include 是X吗 / 是不是X / 是否为X where X is a class or instrument noun (信用卡, 储蓄卡, 人民币, 股票, 港股通, 概念股, 国资, 个人财产). Include 属于 / 算(不算) / 就是…吗 / 一样吗 / 包括…吗 / 计入. Include naming equivalence (可以叫…吗, 是一个部门监管吗) and whether an act legally counts as 违法.
codes.exclude_rules: 是不是 / 是否 used only as a question word in front of a verb phrase (是不是可以买入, 是不能超过12点吗, 是不是一调查就ST了) is not a category question, so code what the verb phrase asks. A/B choices that are rule settings (额度是一年还是终身) go to SERVICE_RULE. A/B choices that are market outcomes (高开还是低开) go to WORLD_STATE. Praise or trust labels (正规, 诈骗, 龙头, 利好, 好事) go to MERIT_SAFETY. Whether a phone number or caller is really a given company goes to MERIT_SAFETY.
examples: 民生银行是国企还是私企
一类卡是信用卡吗
结构性存款属于存款还是理财
保险单和保险合同一样吗
存折算银行卡吗

codes.definition: The user wants to confirm a specific state of the world, not a standing product rule: whether something is so at a given time, has happened, exists, or will happen. Forecasts are included.
codes.include_rules: Include opening hours and trading days of a market or branch (休市 / 开盘 / 上班 / 放假 / 周末办理业务 / 中午能办业务, meaning business in general). Include news and events about a named entity (被罚款, 被列入高风险, 倒闭了, 加息了, 对接银行了, a branch closed). Include market data (主力资金流入, 加仓, 跌破发行价, 某日有交易). Include whether a policy is in force now or from a date (现在有没有贴息政策, 7月1日实行吗), and whether a service becomes available on a date. Include existence of an organisation, branch, ATM or kind of institution, and ownership or partnership facts (有自己的保险公司, 合作银行, 共同持股). Include general-knowledge claims. Include forecasts (会高开还是低开, 能上8元吗, 还会发行新版人民币吗, 有没有可能…).
codes.exclude_rules: Whether a provider offers a product, term or feature (有三年的存单吗, 有运费险吗, 有银条卖吗) and whether a specific operation works at a time (公对公转账晚上能转吗) go to SERVICE_RULE. Whether a stock is a good buy goes to DECISION_ADVICE. Whether an institution will fail, judged as a safety question, goes to MERIT_SAFETY. Board, sector or concept membership goes to CATEGORY_CHECK.
examples: 今天港股休市吗
今天潍城建设银行上班吗？
中国银行是不是被罚款了
连具塘村有ATM机吗
2026年还会发行新版人民币吗

codes.definition: The DEFAULT verification code. The user wants to know how a product, service, institution, market or law works: whether an operation is possible or allowed, and on what terms. Terms include time, place, channel, documents required, fees, limits, quantity, duration and procedure, plus standard product behaviour.
codes.include_rules: Include 可以 / 能 / 可否 / 能不能 + an operation (取 / 存 / 转 / 还 / 提前还 / 退保 in general / 取消 in general / 解绑 / 登录 / 绑定 / 支付 / 查 / 交易 / 变更), with or without an operation condition (不绑卡, 跨行, 在香港, 晚上, 柜台, 信用账户, 20万). Include requirements (需要本人身份证吗, 还得去柜台吗, 要解绑吗, 必须…吗). Include fees and charges for operations the user chooses (转账要钱吗, 取钱收费吗, 办卡需要钱吗). Include limits and rule settings (有没有限额, 是一年还是终身, 能绑定几个). Include offers and features (有三年的吗, 有犹豫期吗, 叠加吗, 有运费险吗). Include product behaviour with no burden on the user (卡号会变吗, 额度会恢复吗, 会有短信吗, 会收回卡吗, 会过期吗). Include whether a general activity is allowed in the country (国内让用虚拟币吗). Include hearsay about a product rule (…这是真的吗, where the claim is a rule).
codes.exclude_rules: Use this code only when no higher code applies. Advice words go to DECISION_ADVICE. Safety, trust or quality goes to MERIT_SAFETY. A marked mishap plus an undo, recovery or still-works question goes to REMEDY_UNDO. A person's status that passes the deletion test, approval odds, or coverage goes to ELIGIBILITY_COVER. Credit, liability, automatic-charge or disclosure consequences go to IMPACT_EXPOSURE. A class or identity question goes to CATEGORY_CHECK. Dated or current events, market or branch hours, and forecasts go to WORLD_STATE.
examples: 定期存款可以提前取吗
公对公转账晚上能转吗
去银行查流水账单需要本人身份证吗
支付宝转账额度是一年还是终身
中国银行二类卡升级一类卡卡号会变吗

codes.definition: The text alone does not show what the user wants from an answer: there is no question to recover, or the question fits two codes equally and nothing in the text breaks the tie.
codes.include_rules: Include statements, opinions or headline-like strings with no question (…取消李渡支行). Include cut-off conditionals that never reach a question (如果办了…，但是…). Include text too garbled to read the question (…能遇吗). Include '可以买吗' about a whole market or asset class with no advice word and no time word, where a rule reading and an advice reading are equally likely. Include rows that point back to earlier context and have no question of their own.
codes.exclude_rules: Do NOT use this code merely because the object or topic is missing while the question type is still clear: 有风险吗 → MERIT_SAFETY, 算利好吗 → MERIT_SAFETY, 可以买入吗 → DECISION_ADVICE, 绑定支付宝能吗 → SERVICE_RULE. Wh-questions (什么 / 哪个 / 几个 / 为什么) are coded by what they ask as though they were yes/no questions (农村商业银行属于什么银行 → CATEGORY_CHECK, 一个身份证可以绑定几个支付宝 → SERVICE_RULE, 为什么不让办一类卡 → ELIGIBILITY_COVER). Non-finance rows that still have a clear question type get that code (银行早上开晨会去晚了算迟到吗 → CATEGORY_CHECK).
examples: 四川农商银行取消李渡支行
A股可以买吗
遇保险单位所交部分能遇吗

codebook.tie_break_order: DECISION_ADVICE > MERIT_SAFETY > REMEDY_UNDO > ELIGIBILITY_COVER > IMPACT_EXPOSURE > CATEGORY_CHECK > WORLD_STATE > SERVICE_RULE > UNSURE_FUNCTION. The rule: the code closest to what the user ultimately wants wins. A recommendation beats a judgement. A judgement beats undoing a mishap. Undoing beats a question that depends on the user's own case. That beats a consequence, which beats a class, a world fact, and finally the default rule question. Apply the include/exclude rules first. The order settles only rows that still meet two definitions after them, for example 可靠吗…能买吗 → DECISION_ADVICE; 收款码可以发给别人吗安全吗 → MERIT_SAFETY; …有必要买吗?…能退回吗? → DECISION_ADVICE; a status question that also says 有影响吗 → ELIGIBILITY_COVER.
codebook.pilot_note: Before drafting, I read all 582 rows and ran a keyword sizing check over every row. It showed a forecast group of only about 9 rows, so forecasts were merged into WORLD_STATE to stay within 8 codes. I then piloted draft v1 on 60 evenly spaced rows (row index floor(k*582/60)+4, for k=0..59). Labels are saved in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-mayouxuan-Documents-Claude-Search-Query-Mining-Agent-Team/3deba04e-73b1-4747-b7b7-4d1a40520650/scratchpad/fin8facet_pilot_VERDICT_QUESTION.csv, with the v1 label kept wherever it differed. Result: v1 gave 7 of 60 rows a label I judged wrong, and 8 more rows had no single clear v1 label; all 15 are fixed in this version. Changes: (1) v1 ELIGIBILITY_COVER took any stated personal attribute, so a 'can I quit my job given my income and debt' row (VER0191) was coded as eligibility. The fix: eligibility now requires a gatekeeper that grants or refuses; with no gatekeeper, personal circumstances go to DECISION_ADVICE. (2) v1 had nothing that separated a real hinge from an incidental mention, so VER0287 (被授权人) was mislabelled. The DELETION TEST was added: the circumstance counts only if removing it makes the question vanish or become an obvious yes; that row now fails the test and goes to SERVICE_RULE. Person words inside product names (大学生助学贷款) and conditions on accounts or operations (信用账户, 不绑卡) are explicitly not applicant circumstances. (3) v1 sent every 影响 to IMPACT_EXPOSURE. Two rows asking whether a car or a bill affects a loan (VER0170, VER0114) are really approval questions, so 'affects my loan / mortgage / card application' moved to ELIGIBILITY_COVER. IMPACT_EXPOSURE is now limited to credit record, liability, automatic charges or premiums, and disclosure. (4) VER0090 (small-business loans 容易吗) triggered MERIT_SAFETY via 容易. Approval odds (容易贷 / 好下 / 能下款) now belong to ELIGIBILITY_COVER. (5) VER0157 (为什么不让办一类卡) had no home in v1. Refusals of access now go to ELIGIBILITY_COVER, and a rule was added: wh-questions are coded by what they ask. (6) VER0505 asks whether repaying at 10 pm 有危险. v1 sent it to MERIT_SAFETY on the cue word, but the danger is a late-payment consequence. Rule-imposed consequences of the user's own timing now go to IMPACT_EXPOSURE; MERIT_SAFETY keeps fraud, theft, failure and quality. (7) REMEDY_UNDO was tightened to require BOTH a marked mishap or existing object AND an undo, recovery or still-works question. 还能 / 还可以 alone, or 注销 / 过户 without an undo question (VER0126, VER0570), now go to SERVICE_RULE. Signs of an existing transaction such as 显示… (VER0284) count as the marker. (8) Four more clarifications. 是不是 / 是否 used only as a question word does not make a row CATEGORY_CHECK. A/B choices that are rule settings go to SERVICE_RULE (VER0117). A credit score update with no stated trigger goes to SERVICE_RULE (VER0277). 买入 with no object is DECISION_ADVICE (VER0410), while 可以买吗 about a whole market with no advice word is UNSURE_FUNCTION. Final pilot distribution: SERVICE_RULE 20, ELIGIBILITY_COVER 12, WORLD_STATE 7, DECISION_ADVICE 6, CATEGORY_CHECK 5, MERIT_SAFETY 4, REMEDY_UNDO 3, IMPACT_EXPOSURE 3, UNSURE_FUNCTION 0. Caveats: this was a single coder with no second opinion, so these are not agreement figures. IMPACT_EXPOSURE and REMEDY_UNDO are small at n=60; keyword sizing over all 582 rows suggests roughly 25-35 rows each, so an agreement estimate for them needs a targeted sample. Every example was checked as a verbatim row in the file. No debt-collection, credit-repair or cash-out row is used as an example; such rows are cited only by sid.
